name: Exp_ColorCoppock
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorCoppock indicator, a momentum-based oscillator derived from the Coppock Curve. It opens buy positions when the histogram turns upward from a decline and sell positions when it turns downward from a rise, with configurable permissions for entry and exit. The strategy operates on a multi-timeframe basis, using a higher timeframe indicator signal to execute trades on the current chart.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorCoppock指标进行交易，该指标是源自Coppock曲线的动量振荡器。当直方图从下降转为上升时开多仓，从上升转为下降时开空仓，并支持配置入场和出场权限。策略采用多周期方式，使用高周期指标信号在当前图表上执行交易。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Coppock曲线的变体ColorCoppock指标，该指标通过双重ROC（变动率）周期计算并经平滑处理生成直方图。入场条件为：当OSC[1]<OSC[2]（前一根柱线直方图下降）且OSC[0]>OSC[1]（当前柱线直方图上升）时产生买入信号；当OSC[1]>OSC[2]且OSC[0]<OSC[1]时产生卖出信号，本质是捕捉动量的拐点反转。出场条件通过独立的买卖平仓权限控制，买入信号同时触发空头平仓，卖出信号同时触发多头平仓。仓位管理使用固定手数或资金比例模式（MM参数为负时为固定手数，为正时为存款比例）。资金管理采用固定点数的止损和止盈，默认止损1000点、止盈2000点，风险回报比为1:2。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the ColorCoppock indicator, a variant of the Coppock Curve that calculates a histogram through dual Rate of Change (ROC) periods smoothed by a configurable moving average method. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when OSC[1]<OSC[2] (histogram declining on the previous bar) and OSC[0]>OSC[1] (histogram rising on the current bar); a sell signal is generated when OSC[1]>OSC[2] and OSC[0]<OSC[1], essentially capturing momentum inflection points. Exit conditions are controlled through independent buy/sell close permissions, where a buy signal also triggers short position closure and a sell signal triggers long position closure. Position sizing uses a dual-mode system where the MM parameter acts as a fixed lot size when negative or as a deposit share percentage when positive. Money management employs fixed point-based stop loss and take profit, defaulting to 1000 points SL and 2000 points TP, yielding a risk-reward ratio of 1:2.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款比例或固定手数，负值为手数
parameters.description_en: Deposit ratio or fixed lot; negative = lot size

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏差点数（滑点容忍度）
parameters.description_en: Max price deviation in points (slippage tolerance)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的柱线索引

pros: 基于Coppock曲线的经典动量策略，逻辑清晰且有历史验证
支持10种平滑算法和11种价格类型，灵活度高
独立的买卖开仓和平仓权限控制，便于精细化管理
使用新柱检测机制避免同一柱内重复交易
多周期架构允许在低周期图表上使用高周期信号
pros_en: Based on the classic Coppock Curve momentum strategy with clear logic and historical validation
Supports 10 smoothing algorithms and 11 price types for high flexibility
Independent buy/sell open and close permission controls enable fine-grained management
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated trading within the same bar
Multi-timeframe architecture allows using higher timeframe signals on lower timeframe charts
cons: 止损止盈使用固定点数而非ATR等动态指标，无法适应市场波动性变化
缺乏加仓和减仓机制，只有全进全出的单一仓位模式
指标参数较多（ROC1、ROC2、XMA方法/周期/相位、价格类型），优化空间大但也容易过拟合
没有点差过滤和交易时间过滤，在不利条件下仍会入场
信号逻辑简单（仅比较相邻三个柱线的直方图值），在震荡市中可能频繁产生虚假信号
cons_en: Stop loss and take profit use fixed points rather than dynamic measures like ATR, unable to adapt to market volatility changes
Lacks position scaling mechanisms, only supporting all-in/all-out single position mode
Many indicator parameters (ROC1, ROC2, XMA method/period/phase, price type) create large optimization space prone to overfitting
No spread filter or trading session filter, will enter trades under unfavorable conditions
Simple signal logic (comparing only three adjacent histogram values) may generate frequent false signals in ranging markets
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈替代固定点数，以适应不同市场波动性
增加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免在高点差和非活跃时段交易
增加趋势强度过滤（如ADX），在震荡市中减少虚假信号
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit to replace fixed points, adapting to different market volatility
Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid trading during high spread and inactive periods
Add trend strength filter (e.g., ADX) to reduce false signals in ranging markets

risk_points: 固定止损点数在高波动市场可能不足，在低波动市场可能过大
缺乏点差过滤，在流动性差的市场中滑点风险较高
动量拐点策略在震荡市中容易反复止损
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss points may be insufficient in high volatility markets and excessive in low volatility markets
Lack of spread filter creates higher slippage risk in low liquidity markets
Momentum inflection strategy is prone to repeated stop-outs in ranging markets
